matriarch.epithet: Armored Queen of the Broad Street Line
matriarch.factoid: Armor 8: machine-gun rounds bounce off her. Railguns and AP Rounds go straight through.

broodMother.factoid: Every quarter of her health she loses births six skitterlings. Sawhorses crumple under her.

armored.factoid: +4 armor and 20% more health: chip damage barely scratches them.

hasted.factoid: 40% faster than usual: walls buy you less time.

regenerating.factoid: Heal 4% of their health every second: burst them down fast.

skitterling.factoid: Fast and flimsy, and there are always more. Anything kills one; nothing kills enough of them.

beetle.factoid: Armor 6: light rounds barely scratch the shell. Hit it hard, or hit it with something that pierces.

wasp.factoid: Airborne: barricades don't stop it and ground-only towers can't touch it. Bring Flak.

grub.factoid: Digs under the streets and your walls, and surfaces near City Hall. Guard the last blocks.

spitter.factoid: Spits acid at towers within 48 m as it walks. Kill it before it gets in range.
